adaptations: Only slate/indigo, sage/teal, mauve/violet and red light/dark hex scales copied into semantic roles; no runtime dependency.

Semantic phase stripes also copy scale11 from blue, amber and crimson (with existing slate/violet/teal), with visible phase/priority text.
